glosses.notes: 运 means carrying or moving people or goods from one place to another, often over some distance.

examples.sentence: 这些菜天亮前就运到了城里的市场。
为了省时间，他们决定连夜把水果运回家。
受伤的人已经运到医院去了，家里人正在那边等他。

example_translations.translation: These vegetables were transported to the city market before daybreak.
To save time, they decided to transport the fruit back home overnight.
The injured person has already been taken to the hospital, and the family is waiting there now.

glosses.notes: 运费 is the money you pay to have something shipped or delivered.

examples.sentence: 这次网购不用付运费，所以我马上下单了。
这件东西本身不贵，运费却一点也不低。
从这里寄到北京，运费要比我想的多不少。

example_translations.translation: This online order has no shipping cost, so I placed the order right away.
The item itself is not expensive, but the shipping cost is not low at all.
The shipping cost from here to Beijing is quite a bit more than I expected.

glosses.notes: 涨 is used when prices, wages, levels, or water go up.

examples.sentence: 最近很多东西都在涨，连水果也比以前贵了。
下了一夜大雨以后，河水第二天涨了很多。
他的工资去年没涨，今年终于涨了一点。

example_translations.translation: Recently a lot of things have been going up in price; even fruit is more expensive than before.
After a night of heavy rain, the river rose a lot the next day.
His salary did not go up last year, but this year it finally rose a little.

glosses.notes: 账号 can mean a login account on a site or app, and it can also mean an account number used to receive or send money.

examples.sentence: 换了手机以后，我还是能用这个账号登录。
要是忘了账号，可以用手机号找回来。
请把钱打到这个账号上，下午我再查一下。

example_translations.translation: Even after changing phones, I can still log in with this account.
If you forget your account, you can recover it with your phone number.
Please transfer the money to this account, and I will check again this afternoon.

glosses.notes: 真诚 is for people, words, or attitudes that come from real feeling and honesty, not politeness alone.

examples.sentence: 她真诚地感谢大家这段时间的帮助。
面对大家的批评，他真诚地承认了自己的问题。
老师说，真诚的态度比漂亮的话更重要。

example_translations.translation: She sincerely thanked everyone for the help they had given her during this time.
Facing everyone's criticism, he sincerely admitted his own problems.
The teacher said that a sincere attitude matters more than nice-sounding words.

glosses.notes: Usually means medicine prescribed in the traditional Chinese medical system, especially herbal medicine.

examples.sentence: 医生看了以后，让她先吃几天中药。
中药太苦了，她每次都要喝很多水。
这家医院除了开中药，也会提醒病人早点休息。

example_translations.translation: After examining her, the doctor told her to take Chinese medicine for a few days first.
The Chinese medicine was so bitter that she drank a lot of water every time.
Besides prescribing Chinese medicine, this hospital also reminds patients to rest early.

glosses.notes: 主席 is the person presiding over a meeting or serving as the titled head of an organization or committee.

examples.sentence: 会议开始以后，主席先介绍了今天的安排。
她去年当选为学生会主席，今年还是一样很忙。
主席听了大家的意见以后，最后做了总结。

example_translations.translation: After the meeting began, the chairperson first introduced today's agenda.
She was elected student union chairperson last year and is still just as busy this year.
After listening to everyone's opinions, the chairperson gave a final summary.

glosses.notes: 专心 describes keeping your mind on one task, class, or piece of work without letting your attention wander.

examples.sentence: 他最近为了准备考试，学习的时候特别专心。
你要是不能专心，就先休息十分钟吧。
做这种工作的时候，一定要很专心。

example_translations.translation: He has been especially focused while studying for the exam lately.
If you cannot stay focused, then rest for ten minutes first.
When doing this kind of work, you have to be very attentive.

glosses.notes: As a verb, it means to make a place look nicer; as a noun, it means decorative items or decoration.

examples.sentence: 她想用花和照片装饰自己的房间。
她买这些装饰，是想让房间更有节日的感觉。
节日前，这家商店会重新装饰门口和窗户。

example_translations.translation: She wants to decorate her room with flowers and photos.
She bought these decorations because she wants the room to feel more festive.
Before the holiday, this shop will redecorate the entrance and windows.

glosses.notes: Usually means hitting a person or thing by accident; for vehicles, it also commonly means collide.

examples.sentence: 他一边说话一边往后走，结果撞到了门口的人。
两辆车在路口撞了以后，司机马上下车看情况。
孩子跑得太快，一转身就撞到我身上了。

example_translations.translation: He was talking while walking backward and ended up bumping into someone by the door.
After two cars collided at the intersection, the drivers got out immediately to check what happened.
The child was running too fast and bumped right into me as soon as he turned around.

glosses.notes: Usually means the way someone holds their body; it can also mean a pose, especially in photos.

examples.sentence: 老师提醒我们写字的时候要注意姿势。
她拍照片的时候，换了好几个姿势。
你坐着看书的姿势不对，时间长了会不舒服。

example_translations.translation: The teacher reminded us to pay attention to our posture when writing.
While taking photos, she changed poses several times.
Your posture when you sit and read is wrong, and after a while it will feel uncomfortable.

glosses.notes: Used for the complete count of people or things after everything has been added up.

examples.sentence: 今年来这里参观的人很多，游客总数已经超过一万。
等我们把名单都看完，就能知道报名总数了。
工作人员还在统计总数，现在不能告诉你结果。

example_translations.translation: A lot of people came to visit this year, and the total number of visitors has already passed ten thousand.
Once we finish checking the list, we will know the total number of registrations.
The staff are still tallying the total number, so they cannot tell you the result yet.
